name: tail-mcp
description: Drive your own logged-in browser tabs from Claude Desktop through a local Tail MCP server
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to a Tail MCP server running on your machine. The server (Docker container or the Tail MCP tray app) talks to a Firefox or Chrome extension inside your own, already-logged-in browser, so pages you automate look like normal browsing — no separate automation browser, no `navigator.webdriver` flag.

**Requirements**

1. A Tail MCP server listening on `http://127.0.0.1:18790` — start the tray app, or run `npm run docker:up` in the [repository](https://github.com/rtf6x/tail-browser-mcp).
2. The Tail MCP browser extension, connected to that server.

This bundle is a stdio-to-HTTP bridge: Claude Desktop starts it locally, and every MCP request is forwarded to your server, so the browser registry and command queue stay in the single long-running server process. Tools become available immediately; `list-connected-browsers` lists the browser IDs.

server_url.title: Tail MCP server URL
server_url.description: Where your Tail MCP server listens. Change this only if you moved the server or Docker publishes a different port.
